title: Declare StorageOptions.GVK for any type shared/aliased across API versions
answers: A type is registered under multiple API versions, how do I make sure writes persist correctly?
checkGVK picked the wrong version for my resource
Do I need to register a new type alias / common multi-version type anywhere?
body: Invariant: if a Go type is registered under more than one GVK in the scheme (e.g. a version alias like v1beta1.Dashboard = v1.Dashboard, apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/v1beta1/register.go), the store for each version must pass an explicit StorageOptions.GVK (via builder.APIGroupOptions.StorageOptsGetterFor) rather than relying on Scheme.ObjectKinds in pkg/storage/unified/apistore/prepare.go:checkGVK, because ObjectKinds returns GVKs in registration order and cannot tell which version a given store serves. Skipping this means encode() persists objects with an apiVersion decided by InstallSchema's registration order, not the actual request version, corrupting stored apiVersion for that type. A test helper exists to catch regressions: pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/register_test.go:assertNoTypeSpansMultipleGVKs (with the commonMultiVersionTypes exception list) fails if a type spans multiple GVKs without a declared-GVK store.
applies: Any resource whose Go struct is reused/aliased across more than one served API version

search: StorageOptions.GVK must be explicitly declared when a Go type is registered under multiple GVKs across API versions (e.g. v1beta1.Dashboard aliased to v1.Dashboard). Omitting this causes pkg/storage/unified/apistore/prepare.go:encode() to persist objects with apiVersion decided by InstallSchema registration order, not the actual request version, corrupting stored metadata. Callers must pass explicit StorageOptions.GVK via builder.APIGroupOptions.StorageOptsGetterFor, because Scheme.ObjectKinds returns GVKs in registration order and cannot distinguish which version a store serves. This applies to any resource whose struct is reused across multiple served versions; the test helper pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/register_test.go:assertNoTypeSpansMultipleGVKs detects regressions. See apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/v1beta1/register.go and prepare.go:checkGVK for examples.
